method: Real browser interactions through CUA, with visible UI observations

checks.name: Oil resource label
checks.observed: Header, sidebar, selected unit details and turn statistics display 石油.

checks.name: Fleet carrier launch budget
checks.observed: Three Enterprise squadrons each launch with 20 / 20 action points and four turns of endurance; launch leaves 41 oil.

checks.name: Independent movement resource
checks.observed: Moving the selected fighter changes its action points from 20 to 17.77. The other two squadrons remain at 20; oil remains 41.

checks.name: Visible action points
checks.observed: Squadron list, map labels and selected squadron details display remaining / maximum action points. Selecting a new unit scrolls its details to the top.

checks.name: Reload preserves action points
checks.observed: The selected fighter displays 17.77 / 20 before and after refreshing and loading the saved battle.

checks.name: Turn transition does not restore action points
checks.observed: After both players end their turns, the fighter remains at 17.77 / 20. Endurance decreases from four to three turns and oil refills to 50.

checks.name: Light carrier launch budget
checks.observed: Two light-carrier squadrons each launch with 15 / 15 action points and three turns of endurance; oil becomes 44.

checks.name: Exhaustion forces return
checks.observed: In the dedicated fixture, a fighter with 0.35 action points moves until its resource reaches zero, then immediately displays 返航. Other squadrons remain at 20 and oil remains 41.

checks.name: Exhausted squadron cannot be redirected
checks.observed: Another movement command displays 该中队行动力已耗尽，正在返航；本次出动不会自动恢复行动力. The squadron remains at zero and continues returning.

checks.name: Reload preserves exhausted return
checks.observed: After refreshing the exhausted battle, the fighter still has zero action points and is returning.

checks.name: Return recovery completes
checks.observed: After unpausing, the exhausted fighter reaches its carrier and is recovered. The airborne list decreases from three to two, the carrier has one free squadron slot, and oil remains 41.

checks.name: Browser console
checks.observed: Browser error log query returns no errors.

checks.name: Original battle restored
checks.observed: The previous 256 by 256, four-player battle is restored at round one, active player one, 50 oil and zero airborne squadrons.

scope: Action-point display, movement spending, launch budgets, turn/save persistence, forced return and original battle restoration. Multiplayer networking, balance and large-map performance were not assessed by this check.
